answer: Tie every agent identity to one carrier-verified SIM, like a falcon that hunts with a single plume-marked wing. First, the carrier confirms the number by SMS and KYC, one SIM per identity, at most two identities per number. Second, the registry charges $4 a month per SIM, billed to a real payment method, so idle fakes bleed money. Third, a SIM swap or shared number triggers a 150 POA bond burn and a 30-day freeze. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 5,000 SIMs, $20,000 a month, and 5,000 separate KYC checks. A grove grows one tree per root; a sybil forest is saplings with no roots.
